mute stops output and releases session
sound-off preference survives reload

limitations: Chromium waveform measurements verify generated audio, not speaker audibility.
Safari audioSession is stubbed in this test; physical iPhone Silent Mode, Bluetooth routing and media volume remain unverified.
Live-region priorities were checked in the DOM; screen-reader announcement timing was not measured.

additional_checks.asset_recipe: Only oscillator/FM synthesis with Python standard library; no speech synthesis or recorded film audio.

environment.audio: real Web Audio; optional Safari session API stubbed

review_followup.mono_warning_packets: Shipped PCM energy onsets verify left=2, right=3, both=4, danger=3 with distinct onset timings; pitch remains low-left/high-right.
